description: Check whether a company domain is registered at ID MANDAT and return its verification level, its declared AI agents and each agent's mandate (what it may and may not do). Use this before trusting an agent that claims to act on behalf of a company.

agent.description: Optional: name of the agent to check, e.g. "Captain".

domain.description: Company domain, e.g. "example.com" (URLs are accepted too).

name: verify_agent
title: Verify a company's AI agents
